- reuse the accepted bounded Task 159-162 running-app evidence without inventing missing metadata; keep the aggregate theme/mode/viewport matrix with Task 164 and P29-01 with its Phase 31 audit owner

## Validation

- pnpm test - 100 files / 1,270 tests passed at pre-close and in the detached preview
- pnpm lint - 0 errors / 11 unchanged warnings
- pnpm typecheck
- pnpm build - seven routes generated
- git diff --check, all seven Gate C artifact-pin validations, and exact-main merge-tree passed
- no Phase 30 Blocking or Advisory finding, active issue, unresolved Tagged impact, owner expansion beyond the accepted Task 162 Workspace pair, or Unowned item remains
